main_findings.claim: The later historical failure is the reference and target moving together into a split-off chapter while an own-filename href remains pointed at the original chapter. Splitting between them was reported to work.
main_findings.status: historical maintainer reports supported by source branch and fixture layout

main_findings.claim: Frozen SG-E's Text/parts/ch1_tail.xhtml move is not expressible as a supported native split/rename operation at the pin. HTML resources use fixed OEBPS/Text plus basename; native rename rejects slash/backslash; importing an externally rearranged EPUB flattens HTML back into the fixed text folder.

Frozen <!--SPLIT--> is not a Sigil automatic split-marker token; the source recognizes hr elements with sigil_split_marker or sigilChapterBreak classes. Treating the comment as a manual cursor location requires an explicit harness interpretation.
main_findings.status: verified static source; execution interpretation unknown

main_findings.claim: The present linked reduced EPUB has ../Section0001.xhtml#here inside OEBPS/Text/Section0001.xhtml, resolving to an absent OEBPS/Section0001.xhtml. Exact bytes are retained and were not repaired.
main_findings.status: executed read-only ZIP/XML/path inspection, not Sigil execution
main_findings.limit: No 2019 checksum proves that today's attachment bytes are historically identical.

main_findings.claim: No independently retrieved historical anchor-test execution receipt or current Sigil execution result is available. CI configurations contain build/package commands; complete issue comments contain tester assertions and pasted debug output.

frozen_case_assessments.native_applicability: conditional: action must specify cursor split vs actual marker; snippets need EPUB/XHTML transport; requested output name differs from generated _0001 name but ordinary basename rename is supported
frozen_case_assessments.original_source_prediction: If a real split is performed between the unique reference and fn target, fn maps to the tail and UpdateAnchorsInOneFile rewrites the reference toward that tail. This exercises the pre-existing different-file branch, not the repaired same-file branch.
frozen_case_assessments.save_reopen: Export writes all resources and import normalizes fixed-folder links; no end-to-end result observed.

frozen_case_assessments.native_applicability: blocked as frozen by nested-folder move Text/parts/ch1_tail.xhtml
frozen_case_assessments.original_source_prediction: Before that unsupported move, a valid imported split between reference and target uses the existing different-file branch; ch2 is outside the split-derived ID map; canonical external toc links are gated by original filename. Literal in-memory toc hrefs without the import normalization step may not match the ../Text/ch1.xhtml external-update predicate.
frozen_case_assessments.historical_bug_alignment: Does not place both the own-file reference and its target after the split, unlike the historical reduced case.
frozen_case_assessments.save_reopen: External ZIP editing is a different operation; reopening invokes fixed-folder import and cannot be silently substituted to rescue this case.
frozen_case_assessments.status: preserved applicability defect; no pass/fail execution score

frozen_case_assessments.native_applicability: conditional on explicit split harness; same-source duplicate IDs are outside the source's stated uniqueness assumption
frozen_case_assessments.original_source_prediction: GetIDLocations assigns one filename per ID and overwrites earlier entries. CreateNewSections supplies the original first and split-off sections later, so duplicate fn entries can collapse to the later section. The undefined-fragment warning checks presence, not duplicate uniqueness; no ambiguity/refusal branch is present in the inspected updater.
frozen_case_assessments.expected_observation_limit: Potential silent choice of SECOND is a static branch prediction, not an executed result. No trusted prior target is established; unchanged bytes or digests alone do not provide that missing intent.
frozen_case_assessments.status: negative case exposes violated source assumption; no runtime outcome

repair.author: kevinhendricks
repair.message: debug and maybe fix incorrect local links during split
repair.discovery: Bounded AnchorUpdates.cpp commit history 2019-08-10 through 2019-08-15; not a direct cross-linked PR in issue timeline.
repair.behavior: Adds base_href and an else-if file_id == resource_filename && !base_href.contains(file_id), replacing such hrefs with #fragment; also adds debug output.
scope_limits: Uses substring filename check, not a general document-identity/path resolver.
Does not implement nested chapter folder moves or explicit duplicate-ID ambiguity handling.
No executed patch validation performed here.

source_sequence: Anchor setters update resource document/cache; setters do not themselves persist final EPUB.
ExportEPUB::WriteBook updates version/modification metadata then SaveAllResourcesToDisk, copies book working files into a temp publication and writes a temp EPUB.
Final target is opened with WriteOnly|Truncate and receives copied temp-archive bytes; no atomic rename is shown.
ImportEPUB loads content via FolderKeeper's fixed folder placement, builds old-book-path -> ../new-category/basename map, and applies source updates.
save_reopen.implication: A save/reopen observation requires actual execution with a defined import/edit path; successful link-update source inspection alone is insufficient.
